code:
# 1:1 / 1:N / M:N 三种联系在 SQL 中的实现与查询验证 (sqlite 实跑)
import sqlite3

con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.executescript("""
-- 1:1  user <- profile  (共享主键 + UNIQUE 保证唯一)
CREATE TABLE user (uid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, uname TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE profile (uid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bio TEXT,
                      FOREIGN KEY (uid) REFERENCES user(uid));
-- 1:N  dept <- emp
CREATE TABLE dept (did INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dname TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE emp  (eid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ename TEXT NOT NULL, did INTEGER NOT NULL,
                   FOREIGN KEY (did) REFERENCES dept(did));
-- M:N  emp <-> project
CREATE TABLE project (pid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pname TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE assignment (eid INTEGER NOT NULL, pid INTEGER NOT NULL, hours INTEGER,
                         PRIMARY KEY (eid, pid),
                         FOREIGN KEY (eid) REFERENCES emp(eid),
                         FOREIGN KEY (pid) REFERENCES project(pid));
INSERT INTO user VALUES (1,'Zhang'),(2,'Li');
INSERT INTO profile VALUES (1,'DB engineer');
INSERT INTO dept VALUES (10,'R&D'),(20,'Ops');
INSERT INTO emp VALUES (100,'A',10),(101,'B',10),(102,'C',20);
INSERT INTO project VALUES (1000,'CppMind'),(2000,'Migrate');
INSERT INTO assignment VALUES (100,1000,40),(101,1000,20),(102,2000,35),(100,2000,10);
""")

print("=== 1:1 / 1:N / M:N 三种联系映射 (sqlite 实跑) ===")
print()

print("[1:1] user <- profile  (外键同时做主键, 天然唯一)")
for r in cur.execute("SELECT u.uid, u.uname, p.bio FROM user u LEFT JOIN profile p ON u.uid=p.uid ORDER BY u.uid"):
    print("  %-4s %-7s %s" % (r[0], r[1], r[2] if r[2] is not None else "(无 profile)"))
print("  没有 profile 的用户也出现在 LEFT JOIN 中 -> 1:1 可选端")
try:
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO profile VALUES (1,'dup')")
    print("  给 uid=1 插第二个 profile -> 未拦截(异常!)")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
    print("  给 uid=1 插第二个 profile -> 被主键拦截: " + str(e))
print()

print("[1:N] dept <- emp  (N 端持有外键)")
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT d.did, d.dname, COUNT(e.eid) AS cnt
FROM dept d LEFT JOIN emp e ON d.did = e.did
GROUP BY d.did, d.dname ORDER BY d.did
"""):
    print("  dept %-4s %-6s 员工数 %d" % r)
try:
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO emp VALUES (200,'D',99)")
    print("  员工指向不存在的部门 99 -> 未拦截(异常!)")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
    print("  员工指向不存在的部门 99 -> 被外键拦截: " + str(e))
print()

print("[M:N] emp <-> project  (中间表 assignment, 复合主键)")
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT e.ename, p.pname, a.hours
FROM assignment a
JOIN emp e ON a.eid = e.eid
JOIN project p ON a.pid = p.pid
ORDER BY e.ename, p.pname
"""):
    print("  %-4s -- %-8s %s h" % r)
print("  中间表行数 = %d" % cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment").fetchone()[0])
print("  每员工参与项目数 / 每项目参与人数:")
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT e.ename, COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN emp e ON a.eid=e.eid
GROUP BY e.ename ORDER BY e.ename
"""):
    print("    %-4s %d 个" % r)
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT p.pname, COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN project p ON a.pid=p.pid
GROUP BY p.pname ORDER BY p.pname
"""):
    print("    %-8s %d 人" % r)
con.close()
